concept.rationale: Abstract visuals better represent intangible ideas and concepts

product.rationale: Products need to be shown in context or with clean, structured backgrounds

service.rationale: Services benefit from human context or clean professional aesthetics

lifestyle.rationale: Lifestyle content needs relatable, aspirational visuals

data.rationale: Data and statistics benefit from structured, analytical visual language

wellness.rationale: Wellness content needs calming, serene visual treatment

tech.rationale: Tech content benefits from modern, cutting-edge visual language

real-estate.rationale: Real estate uses one aspirational hero image plus abstract architectural compositions for designed supporting slides

transformation.rationale: Transformation stories benefit from flowing, progressive visual metaphors

quote.rationale: Quotes need clean, minimal backgrounds that don't compete with text

playful.rationale: Playful brands need energetic, fun visual language

professional.rationale: Professional brands need clean, sophisticated visual treatment

bold.rationale: Bold brands need strong, impactful visual statements

sophisticated.rationale: Sophisticated brands need elegant, refined visual language

modern.rationale: Modern brands need contemporary, cutting-edge visuals

authentic.rationale: Authentic brands need relatable, genuine visual treatment

creative.rationale: Creative brands need expressive, artistic visual language

minimal.rationale: Minimal brands need clean, simple visual treatment

hook.rationale: Hook slides need strong visual impact to stop the scroll

insight.rationale: Insight slides benefit from abstract, conceptual visuals

proof.rationale: Proof slides can use structured visuals or real imagery

tip.rationale: Tip slides benefit from clean, organized visual backgrounds

cta.rationale: CTA slides need clean backgrounds that don't compete with the call-to-action

simple.rationale: Simple carousels work best with one consistent, minimal visual style

medium.rationale: Medium complexity allows for hero slide + consistent supporting style

complex.rationale: Complex carousels can mix styles strategically across slide roles

negativeSpaceRequirement.rationale: Text needs space to breathe without competing with visuals

textZonePlacement.rationale: Different slide roles benefit from different text positioning

visualContinuity.colorConsistency: Use same brand colors across all slides
visualContinuity.styleConsistency: Use 1-2 styles max per carousel, transition intentionally
visualContinuity.lightingConsistency: Maintain consistent lighting treatment if using photography
visualContinuity.rationale: Cohesive visual flow creates professional, branded appearance

mayvenPrinciples.description: Core principles extracted from @mayven_____ Instagram aesthetic
principles: Human-centered lifestyle photography over generic stock imagery
Bold, oversized typography as primary design element (in Figma, not in generated images)
Playful collage effects and contemporary UI references
Bright/pastel accents with controlled color palettes
Clean negative space and intentional breathing room
Cohesive art direction with intentional variety per slide
avoidFailureModes: Neon line icons or dark wireframe grids
Clip-art documents or generic stock scenes
Full AI-generated scene on every slide

applicationStrategy.image-led-slides: 1-2 slides with editorial photography or bold abstract visuals
applicationStrategy.typography-led-slides: Remaining slides with minimal backgrounds (gradients, textures, clean shapes)
applicationStrategy.balance: Mix impactful visuals with clean typography-focused slides
